name: Supahub
summary: A light SaaS feedback-platform style with white canvas, vivid violet CTAs, rounded cards, Bricolage display type, Inter UI copy, floating product previews, and decorative violet-pink-amber gradient orbs.

voltageViolet.role: Primary filled actions, active nav, key accent text

ultraViolet.role: Hover state, deeper gradient stop, emphasis text

lavenderMist.role: Soft decorative violet, icon tints, gradient mid-stops

magentaSpark.role: Pink highlight wash, not primary CTA

midnightInk.role: Primary text, strong borders, dark CTA

pureWhite.role: Canvas, cards, button text, product surfaces

mist.role: Hairline borders, inputs, focus rings, dividers

lavenderField.role: Feature bands and soft emphasis blocks

components.hero: White section with Inter eyebrow, Bricolage headline, supporting paragraph, violet CTA, ghost secondary action, and product mockup.
components.primaryCta: Filled Voltage Violet button with white text, 12px radius, Inter 16px weight 600.
components.ghostButton: Transparent button with 1px Midnight Ink border, 12px radius, Inter label.
components.lavenderFeatureSection: Full-width Lavender Field band with two-column content and dark secondary CTA.
components.testimonialCard: White card with Mist border, 24px radius, avatar, name, handle, quote, and amber stars.
components.floatingProductPreview: White product mockup with 16px radius, traffic-light dots, soft violet shadow, and gradient orb behind it.
components.avatarStack: Overlapping 40px circular avatars with 2px white borders and star rating copy.
components.gradientOrb: Decorative violet, pink, or amber atmosphere behind product cards only.

dos: Use Voltage Violet for the single primary action color.
Keep Bricolage Grotesque at 20px and above.
Place gradient orbs behind product mockups.
Use rounded cards and pill avatars for friendly SaaS texture.
donts: Do not promote pink, amber, or mint to primary CTA colors.
Do not use Bricolage for dense UI copy.
Do not place gradient orbs behind readable text.
Do not rely on heavy card shadows.
Do not stretch hero text across the full 1200px rail.
